drafts.text:
I write the plan at night when nothing's on the line. Calm. Clear. Two ticks and I'm out. Three losers and I'm done for the day.
Then the open happens and that guy never shows up.
The one who shows up wants to be right. He moves the stop "just this once." He forgets the plan was written by someone who wasn't scared yet.
Nobody swaps us out. I do it to myself, every single bell.
drafts.source: Backlog idea held open since 31 ago (the longer confession version of the two-selves aphorism)
drafts.why: Cashes in the backlog idea deliberately saved for this deeper self-quote treatment instead of a quick aphorism. Stake is identity, not money.
drafts.why_es: Cobra la idea del backlog que se guardó a propósito para este tratamiento de autoconfesión más profundo en vez de un aforismo rápido. La apuesta es la identidad, no el dinero.

drafts.text:
Passing the evaluation proves you can follow the rules for a few weeks with nothing real on the line.
Keeping the funded account proves whether you can follow them with real money watching every trade.
Most blowups don't happen during the evaluation. They happen after, once the pressure finally has something to protect.
drafts.source: Universal prop-trading truism, sharpened, deliberately distinct wording from this week's own viral post
drafts.why: Best-reach shape, keeps at least one aphorism in rotation per the standing rule. Same insight class as this week's own viral post but original wording, so it doesn't compete with or echo it.
drafts.why_es: Formato de mayor alcance, mantiene al menos un aforismo en rotación según la regla fija. Misma clase de idea que el post viral propio de esta semana pero con redacción original, para no competir ni hacerle eco.

drafts.text:
The hardest part of this game isn't reading the chart. It's admitting you're wrong fast enough for it to matter.
I'll hold a loser twenty minutes past where I already knew, just so I don't have to say it yet.
Anyone else negotiate with a stop loss like it's a person?
drafts.source: Niche scan (03 sep): the "need to be right vs. profitable" mechanism, reframed as a direct question
drafts.why: Complaint+question is the confirmed strongest recent-week format. Question invites the audience to self-identify, the same lever that drove 61 replies on the "getting chopped" post.
drafts.why_es: Queja + pregunta es el formato más fuerte confirmado de la semana reciente. La pregunta invita a la audiencia a identificarse, la misma palanca que generó 61 respuestas en el post de "getting chopped".

plan: No drafted post should compete with an active real story arc. Hold all 3 until the '10 evals / keeping funded' arc cools off, you're already mining it live better than any draft could. Once it does: Draft 3 (complaint+question, top format) leads late morning CT, Draft 1 (two-selves confession) a couple days later evening CT, Draft 2 (aphorism) held as a standalone whenever there's a gap with no real anchor.
plan_es: Ningún post redactado debería competir con un evento real activo. Guarda los 3 hasta que el arco de '10 evals / mantener lo fondeado' se enfríe, ya lo estás explotando en vivo mejor que cualquier draft. Cuando se enfríe: el Draft 3 (queja+pregunta, formato top) va primero a media mañana CT, el Draft 1 (confesión de los dos yo) un par de días después en la noche, el Draft 2 (aforismo) se guarda como independiente para cuando no haya un evento real ancla.
escalate: If you post another proof-screenshot sequel within 1-2 days of a big post (repeating this week's 15K to 10K pattern), that confirms the sequel mechanism as a repeatable lever, not a one-off. Keep riding real events with a follow-up instead of starting a new draft.
escalate_es: Si publicas otra secuela con captura de pantalla dentro de 1-2 días de un post grande (repitiendo el patrón de esta semana de 15K a 10K), eso confirma el mecanismo de la secuela como una palanca repetible, no algo de una sola vez. Sigue montando eventos reales con un seguimiento en vez de empezar un draft nuevo.

read.watch: New confirmed mechanism: a proof-screenshot sequel 1-2 days after a big post compounds reach instead of just scraping leftovers (15K then 10K). Worth reusing deliberately next time a post goes big. Also: 9 drafts across 3 cycles are still unposted, keep leaning the agent toward fast real-anchor capture over inventing universal drafts. The viral pair's 19+15 replies were never individually mined, that's the richest untapped comment pool right now.

Vale la pena reutilizarlo a propósito la próxima vez que un post explote. Las 19+15 respuestas del par viral nunca se minaron individualmente, es el pozo de comentarios sin explotar más rico ahora mismo.
